properties.Title: Hollis, Harvard, and Massachusetts Halls at Cambridge, N. England / Jonathan Fisher del. et pinx, 1794, no. 6.
properties.Given Information: This watercolor painting by Harvard graduate student Jonathan Fisher depicts Hollis, Harvard, and Massachusetts Halls in the Harvard College Yard in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Small pin holes were punched in every window pane depicted in the painting for artistic effect. The oval gouache drawing is enclosed by an ink border and embellished with two painted ribbons. The top ribbon contains the inscription: "Hollis, Harvard, and Massachusetts Halls, at Cambridge, N. England," and the bottom ribbon contains the handwritten text: Jonathan Fisher del. et. pinx. 1794." The drawing is dated "No. 6."
properties.Added Description: Watercolor painting by Harvard graduate student Jonathan Fisher depicts Hollis, Harvard, and Massachusetts Halls in the Harvard College Yard.
